source.sourceType: manufacturer-checklist-pdf (official Topps checklist PDF, fetched from Topps's own cdn.shopify.com CDN)
source.note: Ingested for real via scripts/checklists/ingest-topps-pdf.js (basketball/football hardening round 5). The real source PDF prints only the CITY per row (no mascot, no trademark symbol). A deterministic, unambiguous city->team map (nfl-city-team-map.js) resolves single-team cities to their real full team name (team field); genuinely ambiguous 2-team markets (Los Angeles, New York) are left as the raw city text rather than guessed. sourceCity always preserves the real raw source value. Discovered via a real external index of the same cdn.shopify.com store path every other persisted product uses (topps.com itself now returns HTTP 403 on every path, so it can no longer be crawled directly), independently structure-checked against its own real fetched PDF text before persisting.
